mapper.sql: s.spare_id, case when s.equip_id is not null then 'EQUIP' else 'CLASS' end as target_kind, s.equip_id, s.equip_class_id, coalesce(e.equip_cd, c.class_cd) as target_cd, coalesce(e.equip_nm, c.class_nm) as target_nm, s.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, i.spec, i.item_type, i.unit_cd, i.use_yn as item_use_yn, s.install_qty, s.key_spare_yn, s.use_yn, s.remark, s.row_ver, s.updated_at, s.updated_by
from cms_equip_spare s join mst_item i on i.item_id = s.item_id left join mst_equip e on e.equip_id = s.equip_id left join mst_equip_class c on c.class_id = s.equip_class_id

where.if: and (i.item_cd like #{keyword} escape '\' or i.item_nm ilike #{keyword} escape '\' or e.equip_cd like #{keyword} escape '\' or e.equip_nm ilike #{keyword} escape '\' or c.class_cd like #{keyword} escape '\' or c.class_nm ilike #{keyword} escape '\')

mapper.select:
select
order by
(s.equip_id is null) i.item_cd i.item_nm s.install_qty s.key_spare_yn s.use_yn coalesce(e.equip_cd, c.class_cd)
desc,
s.spare_id limit #{page.size} offset #{page.offset}
select spare_id from cms_equip_spare where spare_id = #{id} for update

insert into cms_equip_spare (comp_cd, equip_id, equip_class_id, item_id, install_qty, key_spare_yn, use_yn, remark, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{s.equipId}, #{s.equipClassId}, #{s.itemId}, #{s.installQty}, #{s.keySpareYn}, #{s.useYn}, #{s.remark}, #{by}, #{by}) returning spare_id
select item_id, item_cd, item_nm, spec, item_type, unit_cd, use_yn from mst_item where item_cd = #{itemCd}

select item_id, item_cd, item_nm, spec, item_type, unit_cd, use_yn from mst_item where use_yn = 'Y' and (item_cd like #{keyword} escape '\' or item_nm ilike #{keyword} escape '\') order by case when item_type = 'CON' then 0 else 1 end, item_cd limit #{limit}

select distinct on (i.item_cd) i.item_cd, i.item_nm, i.spec, i.unit_cd, s.key_spare_yn, case when s.equip_id is not null then 'EQUIP' else 'CLASS' end as source from cms_equip_spare s join mst_item i on i.item_id = s.item_id where s.use_yn = 'Y' and i.use_yn = 'Y' and (s.equip_id = #{equipId}false or s.equip_class_id = #{classId}) order by i.item_cd, s.equip_id nulls last

select p.part_id, p.mwo_id, p.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, i.spec, p.qty, p.unit_cd, p.remark, p.created_at, p.created_by from cms_mwo_part p join mst_item i on i.item_id = p.item_id where p.mwo_id = #{mwoId} order by p.part_id

insert into cms_mwo_part (comp_cd, mwo_id, item_id, qty, unit_cd, remark, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{mwoId}, #{itemId}, #{qty}, #{unitCd}, #{remark}, #{by}, #{by}) returning part_id
mapper.delete: delete from cms_mwo_part where part_id = #{partId} and mwo_id = #{mwoId}
